basis: Infantile storage neurodegeneration with defining dysostosis; blindness 80-99%. Hearing loss 80-99% and cardiomyopathy 30-79% omitted by cap; organomegaly alone lacks functional impairment.

decisions.musculoskeletal: primary: dysostosis multiplex (4/4) and skeletal dysplasia are defining infantile GM1 features, also reflected in its skeletal-involvement parent.

basis: Acquired proximal tubular injury from degraded tetracycline; generalized solute wasting defines the renal defect.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: none: proximal tubular reabsorption failure defines this renal syndrome; urinary solute losses alone do not establish a metabolic or endocrine disorder.

basis: Brain malformation defines Joubert syndrome; nephronophthisis/ESKD 6/7, scoliosis 3/7 and eyelid ptosis 3/7 support additional axes.

decisions.ocular: involved: eyelid ptosis occurs in 3/7 (~43%), supporting ocular functional impairment; oculomotor apraxia alone is neurologic.

basis: Neuronal/glial degeneration defines NIID; structural vertebral abnormalities and scoliosis are annotated at 30-79%. Weakness and ocular motor signs alone do not establish other organ damage.

decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: HPO lists structural vertebral abnormalities and scoliosis at 30-79%; these support skeletal involvement independently of neurogenic weakness.

basis: Defining B-cell maturation arrest with absent/decreased B cells in 7/7; neutropenia 6/19 (~32%). Pneumonias are separate infections; bronchiectasis 3/19 (~16%).

decisions.haematologic: primary: defining B-cell developmental failure with decreased B cells in 7/7 is a blood-cell disease; neutropenia is additional evidence, not the reason for tier.

basis: Anemia 2/2 with erythroid dysplasia supports blood damage; small cohort limits certainty. Bronchiectasis 2/2 is a separately diagnosed postinfectious complication.

decisions.haematologic: involved: anemia in 2/2 reported patients, with erythroid dysplasia in 1/1, supports blood involvement; estimates are based on few patients.

basis: Gut/airway atresia and fistula define the embryopathy; hypothyroidism 80-99%, cardiac defects 30-79%. Skin, skull and urinary malformations omitted by cap.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: involved: hypothyroidism 80-99% and thyroid abnormalities 30-79% support thyroid dysfunction; thyroid disease does not define the characteristic embryopathy pattern.

basis: Cerebellar/caudate degeneration defines disease. Hearing findings in two assessed patients and ocular/skeletal singletons do not establish >=30% prevalence across the 11-patient series.

decisions.ocular: none: cataract and progressive visual loss are singleton observations; their prevalence across the 11-patient series is not established at >=30%.
decisions.musculoskeletal: none: contracture and scoliosis are singleton observations, without established >=30% prevalence or evidence that they define this disorder.
decisions.otologic: none: hearing loss is reported in only two assessed patients; the 2/2 annotation does not establish >=30% prevalence across the 11-patient series.

basis: Acute lacrimal gland inflammation; this etiologically unspecified concept does not establish infection or autoimmune disease.

decisions.infectious_immune: none: lacrimal inflammation alone does not establish an infectious or autoimmune mechanism; acute dacryoadenitis also has noninfectious causes.

basis: Umbrella of inherited glycosylation defects, including neurologic, muscle and blood phenotypes; group-wide neurologic damage in most patients is not established.

decisions.neurologic: none: the umbrella includes muscle- and blood-limited subtypes; the evidence does not establish neurologic damage in most patients across the group.
